request: Activate the complete Kalaxy3 SAGE mandatory operating contract. Require current Git, GitHub, SAGE, and runtime authority before mutation; evidence-based selection and reuse of repository-owned components; composition manifests; capability-gap receipts; real runtime validation; failure diagnosis that records what failed, what should have been done, which existing component should have been used, why the actual path differed, and the reusable correction; measurable outcome, reuse, authority, failure, rework, and safety statistics; Git credential and history safety; and an operator-executed, visible, one-boundary-at-a-time Git/GitHub mutation gate. Downloaded implementation helpers may edit and validate repository files but may only inspect Git read-only and may not create or switch branches, stage, commit, push, pull, merge, rebase, reset, clean, delete refs, mutate GitHub, or deploy.
required_capability: Read-only Git authority inspection without mixed mutation methods.

candidates_considered.insufficiency: The class exposes fetch, branch creation, staging, commit, and push in the same object.

gap.missing_interface_or_behavior: A separate interface with no mutating methods and no fetch operation.
gap.why_configuration_is_insufficient: Configuration cannot remove public mutating methods from the existing class.
gap.why_composition_is_insufficient: Wrapping the mixed-authority class still grants the helper the prohibited capability.

proposed_primitive.responsibility: Inspect branch, HEAD, local upstream, working-tree state, and exact changed paths through an explicit read-only allowlist.
proposed_primitive.idempotency: Deterministic for unchanged local references and working tree.
proposed_primitive.logging: Versioned git.inspect command events with labels and output digests.
proposed_primitive.failure_mode: Unknown arguments or authority mismatch fail before repository mutation.

approval.rationale: The operator explicitly approved the Phase 2 least-authority safety-foundation gaps.
